programs.title: Chhoti Si Baat
programs.desc: Plot. Chhoti Si Baat is a romantic comedy about a painfully shy young man Arun Pradeep (Amol Palekar), who lacks self-confidence and fails to stand up for his convictions, in the process letting all and sundry walk all over him.

programs.title: Choron Ki Baarat
programs.desc: Anju falls in love with Shekhar and offers him employment under her father. Even though he readily accepts it, she later finds out the real motive behind his actions.

programs.title: Zakhm
programs.desc: The story revolves around a young boy, Ajay, who grows up torn between his mother's Muslim identity and his father's Hindu beliefs. When his mother is killed in a communal riot, Ajay is forced to confront his past and reconcile his conflicted identity. The film explores themes of love, loss, and communal harmony against the backdrop of religious tensions in India.
